July 31, 2026 – 9:30 A.M.
Note: This meeting will be held remotely via MS Teams
Teleconference instructions below
Agenda
1.	Call to Order.
2.	Safety Briefing.
3.	Approval of minutes from April 24, 2026 BPAC meeting.  (Action)
4.	Chair’s Report.
5.	Report from TxDOT’s Public Transportation Division (PTN) Director regarding statewide bicycle and pedestrian matters.
6.	Consideration of TxDOT’s Transportation Alternatives (TA) Program Updates.
7.	Consideration of TxDOT Active Transportation Investment Opportunity Network.
8.	Presentation from North Central Texas Council of Governments on Safe Streets for All (SS4A) Regional Planning.
9.	Updates from committee members on local and statewide issues.
10.	 Public comment – Comments will be accepted by email to BikePed@txdot.gov by August 10, 2026, to be included as part of the meeting record.
11.	 Discussion of agenda items for future BPAC meetings.
12.	 Adjourn.  (Action)
The BPAC meeting will be conducted in English. If you need an interpreter or document translator because English is not your primary language or you have difficulty communicating effectively in English, one will be provided for you. If you have a disability and need assistance, special arrangements can be made to accommodate most needs. If you need interpretation or translation services or you are a person with a disability who requires an accommodation to attend or participate in the BPAC meeting, please contact Elizabeth Jones, Public Transportation Division (PTN), at (214) 535-7261 no later than 4 p.m. CT, July 27, 2026. Please be aware that advance notice is required as some services and accommodations may require time for TxDOT to arrange.
